# Tanya's Sprint Retro

Tanya: "We shipped the async decision widget. Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter. The Zephyr integration was the key unlock."

segments.exact: We shipped the async decision widget.
Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.
The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: The Zephyr integration is spoken of AS a lock-opening mechanism — a thing conceptualized as another thing, not mere vividness.
The 'we' pronoun enacts communal-sharing — the team as an undifferentiated collective that shipped together.
Quantifying output as points frames work in proportionality terms — cost/benefit measurement characteristic of market-pricing.
Framing an integration as the 'key unlock' positions it as the proportional lever — the highest-ROI element that unlocked the rest — a cost/benefit framing.
Shipping a widget performs a competence claim — craft delivered into the world as achievement of capability.
Superlative framing of velocity positions the result as achievement and standing relative to prior performance.
Naming an integration as the decisive enabler of capability frames mastery and craft as the appealed-to good.

payload.focus: Tanya's Sprint Retro: shipping the async decision widget, velocity of 23 points (highest this quarter), Zephyr integration as the key unlock
payload.rationale: This sprint retro (dated 2026-07-20, four months after the prior Sprint 4 retro on 2026-03-22) directly echoes three prior witnesses: Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock (same 'key unlock' claim), Obs_TinaVelocity (same 23-point velocity metric), and Position_Sprint4ThesisProven (thesis proven by the widget). I expanded Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning and Narrative_ZeroEffortCapture to surface the positioning and capture narratives the widget embodies, plus their child positions (anti-pattern, product category, webhook architecture) so the passes can bind this retro to the product thesis rather than minting duplicates. I included the two style observations (metric-anchored claims, direct first-person quotes) because this document uses the same register. I deliberately did NOT expand pricing (Position_PricingTwelveDollars, Position_PricingTier25Plus) or target-market (Position_TargetMarketRemoteTeams) positions — the document makes no claim that bears on pricing or segmentation.
